name: marbled_pour
description: marbled paint: flat inks poured in hard-edged bands and combed into folds, hooks and S-curls that tighten towards the set, no light and no gradient
reuses: stirred_ink's stir: two passes along the level lines of turned copies of the fractal
the paper pass's flat sheets cut from the smooth count, each one ink of the map (gouache_cut's hop)
notes: From wallhaven-xl8gmd (item 089, triage group 11, poured paint), with wallhaven-dp6vvj as the entry teal_marbling. No new engine member: stirred_ink's stir carries the frame, and the paper pass cuts the stirred smooth count into 16 flat sheets on its rank, each one ink of the map (`hop` 0.125 reads the eight inks' middles in turn, so neighbouring bands are far apart on it), so every band is a flat ink with a hard edge and the stir combs the bands into marbling. A thin `shadow` (0.004, colour a dark umber) lays a dark vein along each edge. No light, no gradient, no crest: that is what keeps it apart from stirred_ink, whose one glossy ink is lit along the folds.
Reachable by one escape loop: yes. The frame's loop plus the stir's seven (two passes, 4 and 3 steps), no light, so no Jacobian; the paper pass reads the height the frame already has.

Round one's readings: f_broad (10 sheets: broader bands, closest to xl8gmd's), f_strong (the stir at 7 over 8 steps and 4 over 4), f_flat (no vein), f_nostir (the set's bands as flat inks: poster_curls' look). A dry-brush `ragged` comb (reach 0.012) frayed every edge into noise in the lace and left the drafts. teal_marbling (dp6vvj) walks its map end to end over 14 sheets (`hop` 1/14), a white vein thrown away from the light, and a gentler stir (strength 2 and 2, the fine pass at period 1).

Tone: with equal-area sheets each ink is an eighth of the frame, so the map carries the reference's spread and the tone pass only nudges it. Three re-tunes in round one (creams lowered to L* about 0.82, the dark umber made the first, far-field ink) took the white share from up to 0.15 to 0 and held 6 of 14 picker tiles; the rest miss p10 high (0.21 to 0.24 against 0.153) and three p90 low, at lace-heavy seats where the stirred lace's fine bands average into mid-tone speckle that no tone curve spreads at both ends. Round two's levers: fewer seats in the lace, or the creams back up (p90 now has headroom).

Explorer cost (089, beside renders: an upper bound): 47 s as WebAssembly on one thread at 1280x800 ss2 at its deepest formulation seat (julia-mandelbrot_df5d31a1, maxiter 11,005), whole frame with the paper pass; the paper pass is within the noise of that reading (54 s without it, read just after).
